chapters.title: Mendocino today
chapters.body: The Mendocino AVA lies in Mendocino County, within the North Coast AVA; the UC Davis AVA Project lists it as established on 16 July 1984. Seven AVAs are nested in it, among them Anderson Valley, Potter Valley, Redwood Valley and Yorkville Highlands, and Benmore Valley, Comptche and Eagle Peak Mendocino County also lie inside this frame. The frame runs from the Pacific shore inland; its highest ground, about 1,300 m, is at its east edge. Traces of three faults from the USGS UCERF3 fault model enter the frame: the right-lateral San Andreas (North Coast) and Maacama faults, and the short Wight Way reverse fault. The gold lines are the AVA boundaries.
